Ravi (PM): Quick review please 14: we're debating the compact quickstart banner vs the full-width hero for new workspaces. Prototype: https://img.mock/quickstart-compact-2145.png. Main asks: keyboard carousel behavior, dismiss persistence, and microcopy for CTA. Need quick takes.

Noa (Design): Compact wins for density on smaller screens. But the carousel of sample projects needs clear affordances. Use dots + left/right chevrons; show 3 thumbnails but only one label visible. CTA options: `Use this sample` vs `Try sample` vs `Create from sample`. My pick: `Create from sample` 1: clearer intent.

Kai (Frontend): Carousel + keyboard: arrow keys should navigate slides; Enter activates focused thumbnail CTA. Implementation note: don't hijack left/right if user focus is inside a text field elsewhere. We'll scope key handlers to the banner container when it has focus. Also need `aria-live="polite"` for slide changes and `aria-roledescription="carousel"`.

A11yBot: Auto-a11y scan: missing `aria-controls` for next/prev buttons and slide elements lack `aria-hidden` when offscreen. Also flagged low contrast on the secondary label when theme is dark. Recommend: toggle `aria-hidden` and set `aria-current` on the visible slide.

Tess (Research): From last session: users preferred explicit verbs. `Create from sample` increased intent clarity in usability tests vs `Try sample`. Also note: persistence matters 1: if users dismiss, don't show again for 7 days. If they create a sample, auto-hide permanently.

Noa (Design): Visual tweak: add 8px focus ring to thumbnails, ensure focus order: prev -> thumbnail1 -> thumbnail2 -> thumbnail3 -> next -> cta -> dismiss. Dismiss should be keyboard-accessible and labelled `Dismiss quickstart`.

Kai (Frontend): I'll follow that tab order. For autoplay: we should avoid autoplay due to motion reduction; only allow manual slide. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Ravi (PM): Metrics we care about: `quickstart_banner_cta_click`, `quickstart_banner_dismissed`, `sample_project_created`. Want canary: 10%->40% rollout. Variant A copy: `Create from sample` Variant B: `Start guided quickstart`. Add `variant` to event payload.

A11yBot: One more nit: ensure thumbnails have descriptive alt text (e.g., `alt="Chat sample: streaming replies"`) and that the dismiss button has `aria-label="Dismiss quickstart banner"`.

Noa (Design): I'll update Figma with alt examples and focus styles. Also reduced banner height by 12px to fit in crowded dashboards.

Kai (Frontend): Draft PR coming with keyboard handlers, aria attributes, and analytics hooks. Will link when ready.

Ravi (PM): Thanks team 1: please drop final comments on PR by EOD tomorrow. If no a11y blockers, we'll schedule rollout after QA. :rocket:
